local_review.finding_body: The new latest metadata bucket retained only kotlin/kotlin.kotlin_builtins and omitted conditional registrations already required by Kotlin reflection. Since Spring's unlisted kotlin-reflect 2.3.21 dependency selects the latest bucket, native runs failed first with an unresolved java.util.Set and then with missing reflection access to Executable.getParameters() and Parameter.getName(). This is a contribution-local required-CI regression repairable under contribution-contract disposition 5.1.
local_review.finding_title: Latest Kotlin reflection metadata dropped established native support
local_review.fix_note: Restored the prior bucket's missing conditional reflection registrations and expanded the Kotlin builtins resource glob to kotlin/**/*.kotlin_builtins. Verified with checkMetadataFiles, the full org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-reflect:2.5.0-Beta1 test, and passing local :data:data-jdbc-h2-kotlin and :data:data-jpa-kotlin Spring AOT native tests against the exact smoke-test commit used by CI.
local_review.review_comment: The required Spring AOT jobs failed because the new latest kotlin-reflect metadata was also selected for the unlisted 2.3.21 dependency but had dropped established Kotlin reflection registrations and all builtins resources except the root file. I reviewed the complete target-coordinate diff; it remains scoped, preserves the meaningful test and Native Image execution, uses only reachability-metadata.json, and passes the repair coverage gate (prior N/A is 0/0; new overall is 10/101, reflection 9/100, and resources 1/1). The repaired metadata passed repository validation, the coordinate JVM/native test, and local reproductions of both failed Spring AOT projects.
